overview.description: Inducible expression lets you switch protein production on during exponential growth, avoiding the burden of constitutive expression. For E. coli, time induction by OD600. After inducing, you can lower the temperature to slow folding for complex proteins.
objectives: tune temperature post-induction for correct folding
prerequisites: an expression construct in a host

steps.description: Inducible expression lets you switch protein production on during exponential growth, avoiding the burden of constitutive expression. For E. coli, time induction by OD600. After inducing, you can lower the temperature to slow folding for complex proteins.
steps.intro: Inducible expression lets you switch protein production on during exponential growth, avoiding the burden of constitutive expression. For E. coli, time induction by OD600. After inducing, you can lower the temperature to slow folding for complex proteins.

instructions.title: Grow to phase
instructions.description: Grow cells at 37C with shaking until OD600 reaches the target window for your system.

instructions.title: Induce
instructions.description: Add inducer (e.g. IPTG) to switch on expression.

instructions.title: Tune temperature
instructions.description: For disulphide-bonded/complex proteins, drop the temperature to slow folding and reduce misfolding.

submission.description: Produce a growth curve (OD600 vs time), mark your induction point, and note your post-induction conditions.
